Title: Public preview: Azure Monitor managed service for Prometheus

Body.Content:
Prometheus, the open-source project from the Cloud Native Computing Foundation, is considered the de-facto standard when it comes to monitoring containerized workloads. Running self-managed Prometheus is often a great solution for smaller deployments but scaling this to handle enterprise workloads can be a challenge. 

The new fully managed Prometheus compatible service from Azure Monitor delivers the best of what you like about the open-source ecosystem while automating complex tasks such as scaling, high-availability, and long-term data retention. It is available to use as a standalone service from Azure Monitor or as an integrated component of Container Insights and Azure Managed Grafana. 

Learn more: 

  • Introducing Azure Monitor managed service for Prometheus 
  • Cloud Native K8s monitoring in Azure Monitor 
  • Getting started with Prometheus recording and alert rules 
  • Azure Monitor managed service for Prometheus Documentation
